title: sboardx 1.2 texture file
description: A layer's (or shared drawing's) texture file. See SPEC.md, "Textured strokes (1.2)". Checks the shape of each value only; validate.py checks the rest (cells inside the grid, views inside the atlas, ids that match a path).

atlas_size.description: [W, H]: the atlas size in pixels.

cell_size.description: S, the cell size in pixels: a power of two from 64 to 1024. Writers use 256.

rect.description: Optional. [x, y, w, h]: where the whole atlas sits in the world, for path entries without their own rect.

pages.description: The page PNGs, as archive entry names (images/<name>.png).

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in world units, w and h above 0.

pageName.description: A page's archive entry name: images/<name>.png.

cell.description: [col, row, page, slot_col, slot_row]: the cell's pixels are the S x S square at (slot_col*S, slot_row*S) of pages[page].

path.description: A textured path: id, view, and rect unless the texture has its own rect.

id.description: The id of a <path> in the art SVG.

view.description: [ax, ay, aw, ah]: the atlas pixels the path shows.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h]: where the view is drawn, in world units.
